query: Give the exact HTTP method+path and request/response field names for: AddProject, ListProjects (search), AddAPIApp (auth_method_type enum values), AddOIDCApp, ListApps, AddAppKey (request: type, expiration_date; response: id, key_details), and ListAppKeys. Also: what does key_details contain for KEY_TYPE_JSON (is it a base64 JSON with keyId, key, appId/clientId)? Quote field names.
Quote the exact enum definition of APIAuthMethodType (value names and numbers), and the OIDCAppType and OIDCAuthMethodType enum value names. Nothing else.

For token introspection with private key JWT: (1) What is the exact JSON structure of the downloaded API application key file (field names: type, keyId, key, appId, clientId)? (2) What claims must the client assertion JWT have (iss, sub, aud value, exp, iat) and which header kid? (3) The exact form parameters posted to the introspection endpoint. Quote exact field names.

List every instance-level (IAM_*) manager role and exactly what each can do. In particular: which instance role can create organizations, and create projects and OIDC applications inside any organization? Does IAM_ORG_MANAGER allow creating new organizations? Quote the relevant text.

Find the InternalAuthZ RolePermissionMappings section. For the roles IAM_OWNER, IAM_ORG_MANAGER, and ORG_OWNER, list their permissions verbatim. Specifically answer: does IAM_ORG_MANAGER include "org.create", "project.write", "project.app.write", "project.role.write", "org.idp.write", "user.grant.write"? Quote the exact permission list for IAM_ORG_MANAGER.

What exact redirect/callback URI must be registered at the external OIDC provider for a Zitadel generic OIDC identity provider? Give both the Login V1 and Login V2 variants if the page distinguishes them, verbatim.
